title: picture/snapshot/v1
description: The authority's extra of console/snapshot/v1 (uspace-lab schemas/common/console/snapshot/v1, M29). A snapshot frame validates against the lab's console/snapshot/v1 and against this schema. picture-ws bounds a snapshot to PICTURE_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES of items: active violations first, then tracks, then manned aircraft, each in a stable order. truncated is true when items were left out at the bound; the console then holds a partial picture of its viewport and should narrow it. Live frames of the viewport still arrive for every aircraft.
